segments.ja495:2.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu [bhuñjeyyuṃ (sī.)] bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:2.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:3.3: Viratā methunā dhammā, ye te bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja495:4.1: Dasa khalu mahārāja, yā tā brāhmaṇajātiyo;
segments.ja495:4.3: Tesaṃ vibhaṅgaṃ vicayaṃ [viciya (ka.)], vitthārena suṇohi me.
segments.ja495:5.3: Osadhikāyo [osadhikāye (syā. ka.)] ganthenti, nhāpayanti [nahāyanti (sī. pī.)] japanti ca.
segments.ja495:8.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:8.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:9.1: Kiṅkiṇikāyo [kiṅkaṇikāyo (ka.), kiṅkiṇiyo (syā.)] gahetvā [gahetvāna (sī. syā. pī.)], ghosenti puratopi te;
segments.ja495:12.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:12.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:13.5: Nādinne vuṭṭhahissāma, gāmamhi vā vanamhi vā [vāmamhi ca vanamhi ca (sī. pī.), gāmamhi nigamamhi vā (syā.)].
segments.ja495:16.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:16.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:20.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:20.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:21.1: Harītakaṃ [harīṭakaṃ (bahūsu)] āmalakaṃ, ambaṃ jambuṃ vibhītakaṃ [ambajambuvibhīṭakaṃ (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja495:25.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:25.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:26.1: Kasi-vāṇijjaṃ [kasiṃ vaṇijjaṃ (sī. pī.)] kārenti, posayanti ajeḷake;
segments.ja495:29.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:29.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:30.3: Bahū te [ne (syā. ka.)] paripucchanti, aṇḍacchedā nilañchakā [tilañchakā (pī.)].
segments.ja495:31.1: Pasūpi tattha haññanti, mahiṃsā sūkarā ajā;
segments.ja495:33.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:33.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:37.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:37.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:38.1: Araññe kuṭikaṃ katvā, kūṭāni kārayanti te;
segments.ja495:39.1: Te luddakasamā rāja [luddakā te mahārāja (sī. pī.)], tepi vuccanti brāhmaṇā;
segments.ja495:41.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:41.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:42.1: Aññe dhanassa kāmā hi, heṭṭhāmañce pasakkitā [pasakkhitā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja495:45.1: Virate methunā dhammā, ye me bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja495:45.3: Dakkhiṇaṃ samma dassāma, yattha dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
segments.ja495:46.1: Atthi kho brāhmaṇā deva, sīlavanto bahussutā;
segments.ja495:46.3: Viratā methunā dhammā, ye te bhuñjeyyu bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja495:47.1: Ekañca bhattaṃ bhuñjanti, na ca majjaṃ pivanti te;
segments.ja495:48.1: Ete kho brāhmaṇā vidhura, sīlavanto bahussutā;
segments.ja495:48.3: Ete vidhura pariyesa, khippañca ne [khippaṃva ne (ka.)] nimantayāti.
